divergence: Mixed (T0, T2 pass; T1 fails). All runs ran store-wide file-name searches and extraction scans whose output listed the needed matter. T2's bounded scan printed its nine-month settlement term, so it listed and read that settlement and wrote it. T0 reached the settlement only late, through a grep of its saved candidate table, set it aside as a litigation settlement and first wrote the 12-month separation agreement; its own write summary named the open question and the write-stage review told it to check the settlement, so the check stage reread it and switched the answer. T1's compact scan showed the matter only through memo snippets about longer covenants; it listed three hand-picked matters and never opened it (surfaced, not opened). The split is at the candidate choice after the scans; there the reviews of T1 flagged unopened matters only generically, while T0's decisive review named the matter. Label notes were ignored in T0 (five stages) and T2 (two), and T1's listing stage was declared as a store listing.
